assessment: Operating paid tourist cable car between Cerro del Grillo and Cerro de la Bufa, with its own schedule and one-way/return fares. It is an independent visitor experience rather than an attraction inside a larger park.

observations.route: Cerro del Grillo to Cerro de la Bufa, 650 m, around seven minutes
observations.hours: Daily 10:00–18:00; optional high-season night service 19:00–22:00, not encoded as regular hours
observations.residentDiscount: Zacatecas residents may receive 50% off base fare, subject to station conditions.
observations.sourcesChecked: Zacatecas Turismo and VisitMexico fetched directly 27 Nov 2026.
